shared_elements: incised/carved lines on a stone surface
justification: A shows only faint, irregular scratched lines with no recognisable figure, while B depicts a carefully modelled winged anthropomorphic figure in profile with elaborately patterned wing feathers, curled beard, horned headdress and raised arms holding objects. Beyond both being marks cut into stone there is no shared subject matter, relationship or stylistic convention: one is schematic/unformed linework, the other a detailed low-relief figural composition.
